frozen_protocol.data_scope: synthetic positive-control qualification only; no Tibia input
frozen_protocol.selection: Budget chosen on development only; qualification measured once; no parameter adjustment from its outcomes.
frozen_protocol.development_author: Mary Shelley / Frankenstein, separate from qualification authors

scorers.primary: Frozen Alice first80% tetragrams used for fitting
scorers.secondary: Frankenstein first80% tetragrams used for evaluation only, never key selection

frozen_protocol.independence: Thirty disjoint plaintext excerpts shared across six scenarios. Adjacent same-author excerpts may share phrases/style; thirty excerpts are not thirty authors. No independent-pool claim across scenarios.
frozen_protocol.identifiability: Report unknown-code positions explicitly. seen-code fraction is coverage, not proof that unseen mappings could never be inferred from language.

limits: This qualifies only synthetic fixed homophonic maps with these text lengths/distributions and objective.
The secondary scorer evaluates the selected map and does not constitute a second independent solver.
No failure is a rejection of all homophonic ciphers, especially scenarios not reliably recovered.
No Tibia code or plaintext is read by this program. Reused plaintext across scenarios forbids treating all180 fits as independent evidence.
